sql: SELECT year_month, SUM(actual_attendees) AS actual_attendees FROM serving.analytics.banquet_monthly_metrics WHERE data_period_status = 'ACTUAL' AND is_forecast = false AND year_month >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND year_month < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY year_month ORDER BY year_month LIMIT 1000

SELECT year_month, SUM(cancelled_count) AS cancelled_banquet_count FROM serving.analytics.banquet_monthly_metrics WHERE data_period_status = 'ACTUAL' AND is_forecast = false AND year_month >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND year_month < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY year_month ORDER BY year_month LIMIT 1000

SELECT CAST(SUM(booking_count) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS banquet_booking_count FROM serving.analytics.banquet_monthly_metrics WHERE data_period_status = 'ACTUAL' AND is_forecast = false AND year_month >= DATE '2025-05-01' AND year_month < DATE '2026-05-01' LIMIT 1000

SELECT date_format(date_trunc('month', event_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'), '%Y-%m') AS month, sum(points_delta) AS expired_points FROM crm.dbo.crm_point_transactions WHERE event_at >= date_add('month', -1, from_iso8601_timestamp('2024-01-13T00:00:00+09:00')) AND event_at < from_iso8601_timestamp('2024-01-14T00:00:00+09:00') GROUP BY date_format(date_trunc('month', event_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month LIMIT 1000
